obligations.description: Data Fiduciaries must protect personal data with reasonable security safeguards to prevent a breach.

open_port_mysql.note: Database directly reachable from the internet.

open_port_postgres.note: Database directly reachable from the internet.

open_port_mongodb.note: Database directly reachable from the internet.

open_port_redis.note: Cache/data store directly reachable from the internet.

exposed_git_dir.note: Source code and history publicly exposed.

obligations.clause: Section 8(6) + Rule 7 — breach notification (72h to Board, individuals without delay)
obligations.description: On a personal-data breach, notify the Data Protection Board within 72 hours and affected individuals without delay.

data_breach_history.note: Known historical breach — notification readiness must be proven.

obligations.clause: Section 8(4) (read with ISO 27001 ref in Privacy Rules) — protect data in transit
obligations.description: Personal data must be protected in transit using adequate encryption (ISO/IEC 27001 reference standard).

no_https_redirect.note: HTTP traffic not redirected to HTTPS — data transmitted in cleartext.

missing_hsts.note: HSTS not set — HTTPS not enforced by browser on repeat visits.

ssl_expired.note: Expired SSL certificate breaks encrypted channel.

ssl_invalid.note: Invalid SSL certificate breaks encrypted channel.

insecure_cookies.note: Session cookies transmittable over unencrypted connections.

obligations.clause: Section 8(4) — restrict access to personal data to authorised persons only
obligations.description: Access to personal data must be restricted to authorised personnel; internet-accessible admin interfaces violate this.

open_port_ssh.note: SSH exposed to internet — potential unauthorized remote access vector.

open_port_rdp.note: RDP exposed to internet — brute-forceable remote desktop access.

cors_wildcard.note: Wildcard CORS allows any origin to read authenticated API responses.

obligations.clause: Section 8(4) — prevent unauthorized access via leaked secrets
obligations.description: Leaked credentials or source code enabling unauthorized database access constitutes a failure of reasonable security safeguards.

exposed_env_file.note: Environment file with credentials is publicly accessible.

exposed_git_dir.note: Git repository with potential credential history is publicly accessible.

obligations.description: Report specified cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of detection. Non-compliance: up to Rs. 1 lakh + up to 1 year imprisonment.

obligations.clause: 180-day security log retention within India (IT Act s.70B)
obligations.description: Security and access logs must be retained for a minimum of 180 days and stored within India.

obligations.clause: Section 9 — verifiable parental consent for processing children's personal data
obligations.description: Before processing a child's personal data, verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian must be obtained.
